newsitem.title: FINLAND: Early Helsinki seen off, but may gain ground later.
newsitem.headline: Early Helsinki seen off, but may gain ground later.

text.p: Shares were seen opening lower in calm trade on Wednesday, with Nokia expected to start down after falling on Wall Street overnight, but brokers saw potential for firming on the back of U.S. gains.
"The index will probably start down a bit, but will improve during the day," one broker said, adding that the environment was positive, with the Fed expected to keep U.S. rates steady.

Nokia fell $1 overnight in New York to the equivalent of about 377.90 markka, or more than eight markka below its Helsinki close. But brokers said they expected the stock to recover on the home bourse.

Some brokers said trade could be slack ahead of a decision on interest rates from the U.S. Federal Reserve, but others said there was such strong market consensus that there would be no hike that the Fed meeting would hardly curb activity.
